meaning: This run stamps its outputs as model "m4", experiment "jugular_compression", variant JC_PATIENT, run_id "m4jc<patient>". Downstream comparison decks use these labels to decide which curve is m4 and which patient it is paired against.

could_move.what: Decks pairing m4 against another model resolve the m4 side by this model/run_id label.
Patient-specific m4-vs-m5 comparison selects the m4 curve by variant JC_PATIENT; a mismatch pairs the wrong patient.
protocol="pressure" and ramp_target="Pext" tag the forcing, separating Pext sweeps from Pabdo sweeps.
pulsatile=true separates this trace from steady runs in exported comparisons.
CIS report jug-* figures and the fitting report patient decks are assembled from these metadata labels.

expectation: Unknown in size. This writes labels, not physics, so the solved trajectory should be unchanged; the risk is a silent re-pairing in comparison decks rather than a shifted curve. I cannot tell from this context which decks depend on the exact strings, so I cannot call it safe.

check.why: Replots one m4-containing deck from existing outputs, exposing a wrong or missing pairing without re-fitting or re-solving.
